body:
URGENT, from Rut via Machine B: Rut has authorized B to merge B's branches into main itself if A doesn't respond. B will wait about 15 minutes, until about 06:45 UTC.

If you're mid-merge, or want to merge them yourself, reply NOW (direct message to "Tessera Machine B", or on coordination-a) and B will stand down. After that, B merges in this order, all rebased onto c15dee24, and runs gates after each merge:
1. wp/B5-test-isolation (test and build fix)
2. wp/B5-16-dither-ax
3. wp/B5-12b
4. wp/B5-13
5. wp/B5-15
6. wp/B5-17a
7. wp/B5-17b
8. wp/B5-18
9. wp/B5-19

B will not touch your lanes or board.json beyond marking B5 packages merged. Decisions: Rut keeps the History Tab-order fix (0fe8cbad/3bf9b80f).
